narrative.headline: Smart money is piling into the AI/data-center power-and-silicon stack — electrical equipment, semi-cap equipment, and electronic components dominate the bullish flow.
bullish_themes: AI infrastructure power play: Electrical Equipment & Parts cluster (BE, FCEL, POWL, VRT, AEIS) signals continued conviction in data-center power buildout
Semiconductor equipment strength concentrated in KLAC and ENTG with 95%+ bullish flow, suggesting smart money front-running a capex cycle
Electronic Components broad bid (APH, FLEX, GLW, TTMI) indicates supply-chain positioning behind the AI hardware theme
Computer Hardware bifurcated bullish: SMCI and QBTS show high-conviction asymmetric bets alongside DELL's heavier-premium lean bullish flow
Notable bearish counter-flow in semis (MRVL, ALAB) and semi-cap (ACMR, ONTO) — selective rotation within an otherwise bullish XLK
notable_individual_flows: BE — $20.2M premium at 97% bullish with 43 ask-side prints, the cleanest conviction signal in the scan
INTC — $42.6M premium at 85% bullish, the largest absolute dollar bet on the board
KLAC — $6M premium at 95% bullish on 25 ask-side prints, institutional-grade positioning
SMCI — $4.9M with 57 ask-side bullish prints, retail+institutional convergence
MRVL — $20.8M premium skewing 67% bearish, the most significant counter-signal
narrative.absences: No bullish flow in Solar despite XLB/XLI adjacency — ENPH and RUN actively bearish. Industrials outside the power-equipment niche (URI, CAR, GWW, CAT) are leaning bearish, suggesting the XLI bid is narrow and theme-driven rather than broad cyclical.
